description.value:
Krogan evolved with two hearts, a secondary nervous system, and multiple backup biological systems that can compensate when primary systems fail. A killing blow that should end a krogan may instead find itself absorbed by redundant organ capacity that another species simply does not possess. Krogan have literally walked away from injuries that killed everything around them.

Once per day, when a physical attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points, you can attempt a DC 15 Fortitude save. On a success, you are instead reduced to 1 Hit Point and are not knocked out or dying from that attack. You can only benefit from this ability while you are not dying.
